summary.plain: The collaboration building scintillating bubble chambers: superheated liquid-argon detectors that watch for both bubbles and light, to search for light (GeV-scale) dark matter and to measure reactor neutrino scattering.
summary.technical: Scintillating Bubble Chamber collaboration (Northwestern, Fermilab, Queen's, Alberta, Drexel, UNAM, Indiana University South Bend, UC Riverside, UC Santa Barbara, Montreal, TRIUMF, SNOLAB, Northeastern Illinois among the affiliations on arXiv:2410.07241). Builds two functionally identical 10-kg liquid-argon chambers: SBC-LAr10 at Fermilab (calibration) and SBC-SNOLAB (dark-matter search). No formation date or roster is published in the sources read.
